rule.title: Relocation Payments for No-Fault Evictions Under Section 37.9C
rule.requirement: [Basis: official explanatory text, not operative legal text] For notices of termination served between March 1, 2026 and February 28, 2027 based on owner/relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal of unit, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation, the landlord must pay $8,245.00 per tenant up to a maximum of $24,733.00 per unit, plus an additional $5,497.00 for each elderly tenant (60 years or older), disabled tenant, or household with minor child(ren).
rule.key_value: $8,245.00 per tenant; $24,733.00 max per unit; $5,497.00 additional per elderly/disabled/minor child household

rule.interaction: The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
